title: Bailong Elevator - 326 meters straight up
text: Bailong is the tallest outdoor elevator in the world, a Guinness record holder. It carries visitors to the top of the Avatar Mountains plateau in just 92 seconds. Height 326 m, speed 3 m/s, capacity 50 people, ticket 65 yuan one-way.

title: Winter in Zhangjiajie (December-February)
text: Surprisingly beautiful! Snow-covered pillars look like another planet. Temperatures 0 to +8 C, occasional snow. Fewer tourists, lower prices and unique views - winter Zhangjiajie is a secret few travelers know.

title: Autumn in Zhangjiajie (September-November)
text: The best time to visit! Temperatures of +15 to +25 C, little rain and incredible colors - red maples and golden ginkgos against quartzite pillars. October is ideal, but avoid the Golden Week crowds in the first week.

title: Summer in Zhangjiajie (June-August)
text: Hot and humid: +28 to +35 C, humidity up to 90%. It is peak season with crowds of Chinese tourists. Longest daylight, lush green mountains and all routes open, but Bailong Elevator lines can reach 1-2 hours.

title: Spring in Zhangjiajie (March-May)
text: Spring is one of the best times to visit the park. Temperatures of +15 to +25 C, rhododendrons and mountain flowers bloom. Frequent fog and rain create that iconic Avatar atmosphere - the quartzite pillars literally float among the clouds.
